means: The literal danbooru tag for a background thrown out of focus behind a sharp subject.
does: Really works, and it is the tag that does the actual work every time somebody means shallow depth of field. Across the shot_focus_dof sweep the far plane went from fully drawn crowd detail (deep) to a soft wash (shallow) to dissolved bokeh circles (very_shallow), with the figure staying sharp throughout. Second, quieter consequence: it HIDES the model's background failures. Duplicated limbs, garbled crowd faces and impossible architecture in the far plane stop mattering once they are a blur, which makes this the cheapest quality win available on a busy scene.
reach_for_it: any close-up or dialogue shot, and any shot with a crowd or complicated architecture behind the subject. Pair it with "depth of field" and "bokeh" - the trio is what the sweep actually tested.
used_in: shot.focus.dof shallow and very_shallow, shot.focus.point subject/face/prop; the shot.lens.bokeh_shape review prescribes adding it to every panel of that card because without it there is no bokeh to shape
